title: geranium crenatifolium
intro: Geranium crenatifolium, commonly known as the Mountain geranium, is a species of flowering plant in the family Geraniaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of Geranium crenatifolium are attributed to its ability to balance the body's energy and promote relaxation, as well as its antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include geraniol, linalool, and beta-caryophyllene, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic uses.
